memoryAcquisition.policy: Concurrent per-PID smaps_rollup reads, cap4, all joined inside the original complete before/after process-inventory bracket; deterministic PID order.
memoryAcquisition.scope: Diagnostic non-atomic import-window samples only. All earlier serial acquisitions and failures remain unchanged and unpooled.
memoryAcquisition.eligibility: Original stable tree/identity and readability rules, pre/post brackets, at least5 fully contained scans and maximum250ms coverage gap remain unchanged.
memoryAcquisition.cadence: Original25ms wait during import and100ms after import.
memoryAcquisition.limitations: No acquisition-speed claim or equivalence of sampled process peaks across different acquisition policies. Not a hard total-process memory cap.

failurePolicy: Keep every complete/failed observation; no trimming, control subtraction, replacement or host pooling. Stop a dictionary cell on an ordinary semantic failure.
